title: Durable Workflow Replay
hints: Drive the generator by hand: gen.send(value), or gen.throw(error) when the last activity failed. StopIteration.value is the workflow's result.
Keep a sequence counter. While seq < len(history), the event at history[seq] must match the command by name and by canonical args; then feed its result or re-raise its error.
Past the end of the history, run the activity live and append its event to `history` before resuming the workflow. A crash right after must not lose it.
When the workflow returns, check that it consumed the whole history. Leftover events mean the code changed under a running workflow.
